message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"All evaluated designs meet the 60 dB SQNR requirement, and the symmetric_preadd structure at coef_frac=14 has the smallest mapped area so far (8552.17 um^2). Decreasing precision by one legal level is available and may further reduce area while likely preserving the quality constraint, whereas increasing precision is unavailable and switching architecture/rounding has less clear area benefit."}
